operationMappings.readAccessibility: readAccessibility(input: BinaryInput, options: ShapeSelection, context: SelectionContext): Promise<{objects: AccessibilityObject[]; slides: AccessibilitySlideCheck[]; order: "structural"; limitations: string[]}>. Detached noncreating records, not live shape collections.
operationMappings.mutateAccessibility: mutateAccessibility(input: BinaryInput, options: ShapeSelection & {update: AccessibilityUpdate}, context: SelectionContext): Promise<{bytes: Uint8Array; affected: number; affectedSlides: number[]; records: readonly SelectionRecord[]}>. Update fields are altText?: string, title?: string, decorative?: boolean. description is an output alias, not a supported update key.
operationMappings.cli: accessibility list/get/set; --alt-text, --title, --decorative per appendix. Both SDK and CLI expose description as an output alias of altText. CLI scopes are slides/layouts/masters; SDK shared+part targets the same shared object that CLI addresses by the opaque token returned by layouts/masters inspection.
operationMappings.security: No ambient host I/O, time, native runtime, network, renderer or embedded-content execution; input and publication use caller capabilities. Validated own data-property values, including nonenumerable selection fields, are captured before asynchronous admission; accessor fields are rejected without invocation. Byte-capability callbacks cannot change accepted selections or metadata. Unknown XML is retained; external relationships are not followed.
operationMappings.null: Absent metadata remains null; empty text is explicit; omitted updates preserve existing attributes. Missing optional decorative val has no schema default and must not be promoted to true.
operationMappings.collections: Detached arrays follow deterministic structural XML traversal. They are not live model sequence implementations; CLI slide positions are one-based and opaque selectors retain owner fingerprints.
operationMappings.errors: Stored keys/types/XML characters are validated before admission; description as an update key is rejected. OfficeError codes feed shared version-1 envelopes; selection ambiguity/staleness and publication retain common semantics.
